hack.root_cause: Donation Function Bypassing Health Check (Logic Bug in EIP-14 upgrade)
hack.description: An attacker used Euler's own leverage system and a donation function that skipped health checks to manufacture bad debt, then liquidated it at a discount — draining $197M from one of DeFi's most audited lending protocols.
